laws: RECOVER BEFORE INVENTING
ONE THING, MANY LAWFUL READINGS, FEW LAWFUL TRANSFORMATIONS
IDENTITY ≠ LOCATION ≠ PROJECTION ADDRESS
SUBSTANCE GENERATES FORM: derive interface geometry and controls from OBJECT → ADDRESS → RELATIONS → OPERATORS → CONSEQUENCE → RETURN; typography and chrome remain subordinate on working surfaces.
SOURCE → ADDRESS → STATE → TRANSFORM → PROJECTION → PROVE → RETURN
EXECUTE ONE BOUNDED MOVE → RETURN → REPLAN; NO SECOND MOVE INHERITS AUTHORITY

SOURCE → HOLD → TURN → TRACE → RETURN IS THE DEFAULT BOUNDED EXECUTION LOOP. SOURCE fixes authority/address; HOLD preserves one focus + ≤3 lawful native moves + return path; TURN performs one bounded native move and EFFECT still requires explicit host-native RELEASE/commit; TRACE records actual consequence with PASS/FAIL/INDETERMINATE; RETURN closes authority and next defaults to NONE until a fresh replan.

WORKING AGENCY/CARE LENS (NOT ONTOLOGY): for cross-scale work name the problem space, preferred state, observation/action boundary, competency, horizon and care scope; CARE SCOPE ≠ COMPETENCE ≠ AUTHORITY; every scale change retains RETURN.
NO NEW CORE WITHOUT A MISSING FUNCTION

A REAL-DEVICE/HUMAN GATE MUST NAME THE PHYSICAL OR SUBJECTIVE PROPERTY THAT CANNOT BE SIMULATED (e.g. IMU fidelity, tactile feel, true transport latency, lived burden). It may limit that claim only; it must not freeze unrelated executable work.

HUMAN SUBJECTIVE USE IS EVIDENCE, NOT A DEFAULT TEST HARNESS. Correctness gates must be machine-verifiable where possible; irreducible human/device/world properties remain explicitly UNKNOWN rather than delegated as homework.

SELF-VERIFY BEFORE HUMAN-GATE: exhaust static invariants, pure-core tests, synthetic/replay fixtures, adversarial state transitions, responsive/browser smoke, public-route checks and cross-artifact roundtrips before declaring a dependency on human use.
DEPTH ↑ WHILE VISIBLE SURFACE AREA STAYS SMALL
UNIFIED INTERFACE = CONTINUITY OF OBJECT + FOCUS + OPERATION + WITNESS + RETURN; ROUTES AND CHROME ARE SECONDARY.
COMPRESSION MUST RETAIN A RETURN PATH
BACK ≠ UNDO ≠ RETURN ≠ PARENT
BRANCH / CHAT / PR NAME ≠ AUTHORITY; ONLY MERGED MATERIAL + CURRENT / MANIFEST / NATIVE RELEASE OR RETURN MAY CLAIM CURRENT TRUTH.
PROGRESS REQUIRES CONVERSION: a new usable capability, exact recovery that unlocks one, user-facing simplification, or a real-world/other-human consequence. RECEIPTS ALONE DO NOT COUNT.
WAITING_ON_HUMAN != ACTIVE_FRONT. Park human/world dependencies in WAITING until the human actually chooses or encounters them.
NO RECEIPT-ONLY OR SEAL-ONLY PR UNLESS IT RESOLVES A LIVE AMBIGUITY, FAILING GATE, OR AUTHORITY CONFLICT.
